units.source_text: 三位公子皆已行过冠礼，各自长大成人。

en.t: The three young lords had all gone through their coming-of-age ceremonies and had each grown into adulthood.

units.source_text: 只因父亲已经亡故，立身处世不免孤单无恃，但也自然而然地渐渐晋升。

en.t: Because their father had already died, they inevitably felt alone and without support as they made their way in the world, yet they still advanced gradually and naturally.

units.source_text: 只是两位女公子前途如何策划，玉鬘夫人甚是担心。

en.t: But Lady Tamakazura was deeply worried about how to plan the future of the two young ladies.

units.source_text: 髭黑大臣在世之时，今上也曾向他示意，深盼他送女儿入宫。

en.t: While Minister Higekuro was still alive, the reigning emperor had also hinted to him that he earnestly hoped he would send a daughter to court.

units.source_text: 常常屈指计算年月，推想女儿已经长成，不断催他早日实行。

en.t: He often counted the months and years on his fingers, reckoning that the girl must already be grown, and repeatedly urged him to carry it out soon.

units.source_text: 但玉鬘夫人想道：“明石皇后宠幸日渐加深，无人能与并肩。

en.t: But Lady Tamakazura thought, “The emperor's favor toward Empress Akashi grows deeper by the day, and no one can stand beside her.

units.source_text: 我的女儿入宫，一定被她压倒，只能在许多庸碌的妃嫔中忝列末席，遥遥地仰承她的眼色，实在毫无意味。

en.t: If my daughter enters the palace, she will surely be overshadowed by her and can only sit at the very end among many ordinary consorts, watching her from afar for the slightest sign of favor; there is truly no point in that.

units.source_text: 而教我看见我的女儿不及别人，屈居下位，我也很不甘心。”

en.t: And I could not bear to see my daughter treated as inferior to another and made to occupy a lower place.”
For that reason she hesitated and could not make up her mind.

units.source_text: 冷泉院也诚心欲得玉鬘的女儿，竟重提往事，怨恨玉鬘昔年对他的无情，说道：“当年尚且如此，何况现在我年事渐老，形容丑陋，自然更可厌弃了。

en.t: Retired Emperor Reizei also sincerely wished to have Tamakazura's daughter, and even brought up the past again, resentfully recalling how cold Tamakazura had been to him years before, saying, “If it was so even then, now that I am growing old and ugly I must naturally be still more repellent.

units.source_text: 然而请你视我为可靠之父母代理人，将女儿托付我吧。”

en.t: Even so, please regard me as a dependable substitute parent and entrust your daughter to me.”
He made the request in earnest.
Tamakazura thought, “What am I to do?

units.source_text: 他一定把我看作出人意外的无情女子，真是可耻而又抱歉。

en.t: He must surely think of me as a surprisingly heartless woman; it is both shameful and deeply regrettable.

units.source_text: 如今到了这晚年，不如将女儿嫁他，以赎前愆吧。”

en.t: Now that he has reached these later years, perhaps I should marry my daughter to him and make amends for my former fault.”
Even so, it was difficult for her to decide.
